label: Bluebook Practice Test 4
note: Paraphrases only: never store official question text, passages, or answer choices here.

mistakes.summary: Blank after "critics' concerns didn't ___ an advocate's efforts"; the effort succeeded anyway.
mistakes.lesson: Use the negation + outcome clue; predict "hold back" before reading options.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q1

mistakes.summary: Artisans typically ___ inherited techniques "but don't strictly observe every tradition".
mistakes.lesson: "But not strictly every" means the blank is the opposite: follow closely.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q2

mistakes.summary: Historians ___ something based on an assumption that later data disproved.
mistakes.lesson: Vocabulary: surmise = guess with little evidence; contrive = create by trickery.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q5

mistakes.summary: Scholars who see a writer's wife only as his inspiration ___ (answer: risk misrepresenting her own literary contributions).
mistakes.lesson: The completion must follow the passage's focus; reject options about things the text never discusses.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q12

mistakes.summary: A long introductory phrase, then subject (a full name), then verb.
mistakes.lesson: Never put a single punctuation mark between subject and verb.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q14

mistakes.summary: Plural possessive + plural noun about many snow grains.
mistakes.lesson: Plural owner = s'; the owned noun takes no apostrophe.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q16

mistakes.summary: A "that" clause about a model's prediction needs a main verb.
mistakes.lesson: A clause needs a finite verb; -ing / to-infinitive can't be the main verb.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q20

mistakes.summary: Sentence 2 intensifies sentence 1 (research is "its own reward" → "as fascinating as travel").
mistakes.lesson: Likewise = separate similar point; In fact = stronger support of the same point.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q21

mistakes.summary: Goal: "present the study and its findings". I chose an option with the researcher's initial uncertainty but no findings.
mistakes.lesson: Read the goal first; cross out options missing a required element (findings).
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q23

mistakes.summary: Goal: "summarize the study". I chose the study's aim only.
mistakes.lesson: A summary = who/when + what was studied + result.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 1 Q26

mistakes.summary: "On the other hand" contrasts damaged plants with ___ plants.
mistakes.lesson: Contrast signal → antonym of the first description.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 2 Q2

mistakes.summary: Other researchers readily ___ a paper as groundbreaking ("this recognition…").
mistakes.lesson: Vocabulary: ensure = make certain; acknowledge = recognize.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 2 Q3

mistakes.summary: A council makes laws; officials ___ them by devising policies in accordance with them.
mistakes.lesson: Implement = put into effect; improvise = do without preparation.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 2 Q4

mistakes.summary: Pick the quote showing a character as hard-working and dedicated; I picked a quote about him being happy after payment.
mistakes.lesson: Split the claim into parts; the quote must show every part.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 2 Q11

mistakes.summary: Poem quote showing nature as an active participant in a nighttime water scene; I picked a static-moon line with no water.
mistakes.lesson: Checklist the claim: element of nature + active + night + water.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Reading and Writing Module 2 Q12

mistakes.summary: Interpret the y-intercept of a decay graph where y is in thousands of catalogs, x = years since end of 1992. Answer: 9,000 catalogs at end of 1992.
mistakes.lesson: y-intercept = value at x = 0; apply units ("in thousands"); it's a single-year value, not a total.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 1 Q15

mistakes.summary: "Minimum value of x is 12 less than 6 times n".
mistakes.lesson: Minimum → ≥; maximum → ≤.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 1 Q20

mistakes.summary: Line 9x − 10y = 19 shifted down 4; find the new x-intercept.
mistakes.lesson: Down k: replace y with (y + k): 9x − 10(y+4) = 19 → 9x − 10y = 59 → x = 59/9.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 1 Q22

mistakes.summary: Table of 3 points (−1, 10), (0, 14), (1, 20); choose the equation.
mistakes.lesson: Plug the table points into options (or Desmos regression). Easy item: I omitted it, a timing issue.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q5

mistakes.summary: Parallel lines + transversal; vertical angles x = 6k+13 and y = 8k−29; z is same-side interior with y.
mistakes.lesson: Vertical angles are equal → k = 21; same-side interior angles sum to 180 → z = 41. Trap options: k (21), x (139).
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q7

mistakes.summary: Slope of a line perpendicular to 2y + 18x = 9.
mistakes.lesson: Perpendicular = negative reciprocal (flip AND change sign).
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q8

mistakes.summary: P(t) = 290(1.04)^((4/6)t); percent increase every 18 months.
mistakes.lesson: Convert the time unit; the multiplier 1.04 means +4%.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q10

mistakes.summary: 2(kx − n) = −(28/15)x − 36/19 with n > 1 has no solution; find k.
mistakes.lesson: No solution: equal x-coefficients, different constants.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q11

mistakes.summary: Wholesale $7, retail 290% of wholesale, then 80% off retail.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q12

mistakes.summary: x² − 34x + c = 0 has no real solutions if c > n; least n.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q13

mistakes.summary: Combine means of two data sets with different sizes (75 at 32, 50 at 62).
mistakes.lesson: Weighted mean = total sum ÷ total count, not the average of averages.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q14

mistakes.summary: 4x² + bx − 45 = (hx + k)(x + j), integers; which must be an integer.
mistakes.lesson: Expand and match: kj = −45 → j = −45/k. Test options with real values.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q15

mistakes.summary: Add 56 to each value of a dot-plot data set: compare medians and ranges.
mistakes.lesson: Adding a constant shifts center (median up), spread (range) unchanged.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q17

mistakes.summary: f(x) = a/(x+b) from a partial graph through (−7, −2) and (−5, −6); g(x) = f(x+4).
mistakes.lesson: Two points → two equations → a = 6, b = 4; then replace x by (x+4).
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q18

mistakes.summary: 57x² + (57b + a)x + ab = 0; product of solutions = kab.
mistakes.lesson: Product of roots = c/a = ab/57.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q19

mistakes.summary: x² + x + y² + y = 199/2; radius.
mistakes.lesson: Complete the square and add 1/4 + 1/4 to the right side too.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q20

mistakes.summary: Two identical square-base prisms (height 90) glued along a base; new surface area = (92/47)K; base side.
mistakes.lesson: New SA = 2K − 2x²; K = 2x² + 360x → x = 8.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q21

mistakes.summary: Parabola vertex (9, −14) with two x-intercepts; which could be a + b + c.
mistakes.lesson: a + b + c = y(1) = 64a − 14; opens up (a > 0) → only −12 works.
mistakes.where_to_review: Bluebook → My Practice → Practice Test 4 → Math Module 2 Q22
